title: Query Plans & SQL Performance
interviewAnswer: A query optimizer chooses scans, joins and access paths based on statistics and indexes. Explain plans reveal whether a slow query is scanning too much, joining badly or missing useful indexes/partition pruning.
keyPoints: Index presence does not guarantee index use.
Predicate pushdown and partition pruning reduce data read.
why: Query Plans & SQL Performance is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
intuition: Index presence does not guarantee index use.
deepDive: A query optimizer chooses scans, joins and access paths based on statistics and indexes. Explain plans reveal whether a slow query is scanning too much, joining badly or missing useful indexes/partition pruning. Join order/algorithm matters. Predicate pushdown and partition pruning reduce data read. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Use EXPLAIN to discover a full scan on a billion-row event table where a selective index/partition could help.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
